renewal.note: Single-season limited run concluded May 18, 2024. A prequel to the classic MBC series Chief Inspector (1971-1989), it was conceived as a standalone origin story.

bollymeter.basis: Averaged a strong 9.5% nationwide rating on MBC, peaking at 10.8% - exceptional for a period drama. Critics and audiences praised Lee Je-hoon's charismatic lead and the show's warm, retro procedural energy.

seasons.review_body: Chief Detective 1958 aired April through May 2024 on MBC, a prequel to the beloved classic Chief Inspector that ran from 1971 to 1989. The ten-episode limited run followed four idiosyncratic detectives in 1950s Seoul solving crimes without modern forensics, relying on tenacity, intuition, and a defiant streak against the corrupt power structures of the era. The series averaged 9.5% nationwide ratings (Nielsen Korea), peaking at 10.8% in episode three - strong numbers for a period procedural on a public broadcaster. Lee Je-hoon's lead performance anchored consistent praise across Korean entertainment press, who noted the show's ability to blend period atmosphere with comedic warmth and genre tension. The retro setting translated into a distinct visual identity that separated it from contemporary crime dramas.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 1
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The premiere establishes the ragtag detective unit in post-Korean War Seoul, where the city's chaos and corruption provide the backdrop for the first investigation. Lee Je-hoon's Park Yeong-han arrives fully formed - morally driven, procedurally unorthodox, and immediately compelling. The period production design sets a confident visual tone.
episode_reviews.the_moment: Park Yeong-han confronts a corrupt official bare-handed, establishing the show's refusal to play by the rules of its own era.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 10
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The finale wraps the central arc with the kind of emotionally satisfying resolution that rewards the full ensemble - each detective gets their moment. The episode sustains the series' commitment to period authenticity while delivering the genre catharsis that drove viewership to season-high territory.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The unit's final case closes in a way that nods to the long legacy of the original Chief Inspector series it precedes.
